quotes.quote: The food and service were great! … Everything was seasoned well and was fresh. The salsa has just the perfect amount of spices and not overkill. The server was very attentive and friendly.
quotes.author: Angie D.

quotes.quote: Friendly staff. Chips are warm and crisp, tasty sauce with a little twist… Food served hot, from the stove to the table. Definitely recommended to all.
quotes.author: Yi S.
